recommendations.title: Refresh: Add installation cost examples and total-price scenarios
recommendations.details: Add a section to https://optimeraenergi.se/guider/installera-laddbox-hemma that shows concrete total-price scenarios (simple wall-mounted box, mid-range with moderate cable work, complex freestanding pole with groundwork). For each scenario include: itemized costs (box, installation labour, cable, earthworks, extra protections), subtotal, estimated green tax reduction and final out-of-pocket cost. Use clear assumptions (e.g., cable length, need for new jordfelsbrytare) so readers can map to their situation.
